GRADE 7 CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe categories of Creative Arts and Sports,
   B. Learners should ignore Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports completely.
   C. Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

2. About Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. outline the relationships among the categories of Creative Arts and Sports,
   B. Learners should ignore Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports completely.
   C. Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

3. About Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. make a collage on the categories of the Creative Arts and Sports,
   B. Learners should ignore Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports completely.
   C. Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

5. About Components of Creative Arts and Sports at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe elements of a story,
   B. Learners should ignore Components of Creative Arts and Sports completely.
   C. Components of Creative Arts and Sports is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

6. About Components of Creative Arts and Sports at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform activities demonstrating the components of fitness,
   B. Learners should ignore Components of Creative Arts and Sports completely.
   C. Components of Creative Arts and Sports is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

7. About Components of Creative Arts and Sports when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. write note values on a treble staff,
   B. Learners should ignore Components of Creative Arts and Sports completely.
   C. Components of Creative Arts and Sports is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

9. About Drawing and Painting at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. explain balance in a picture,
   B. Learners should ignore Drawing and Painting completely.
   C. Drawing and Painting is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Drawing and Painting.

10. About Drawing and Painting at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. draw a picture to apply balance,
   B. Learners should ignore Drawing and Painting completely.
   C. Drawing and Painting is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Drawing and Painting.

11. About Drawing and Painting when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. analyse cool and warm colours for colour temperature,
   B. Learners should ignore Drawing and Painting completely.
   C. Drawing and Painting is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Drawing and Painting.

13. About Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. discuss function of jewellery in Kenyan communities,
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

14. About Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. identify materials for beadwork in the local environment,
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

15. About Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. make beaded jewellery inspired by patriotism for Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

17. About Swimming at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe different ways of water entry in a pool,
   B. Learners should ignore Swimming completely.
   C. Swimming is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Swimming.

18. About Swimming at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform a crouch dive into the swimming pool,
   B. Learners should ignore Swimming completely.
   C. Swimming is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Swimming.

19. About Swimming when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. execute a water entry skill using a pencil dive,
   B. Learners should ignore Swimming completely.
   C. Swimming is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Swimming.

21. About Kenyan Indigenous Games at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe different ways of water entry in a pool,
   B. Learners should ignore Kenyan Indigenous Games completely.
   C. Kenyan Indigenous Games is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kenyan Indigenous Games.

22. About Kenyan Indigenous Games at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform a crouch dive into the swimming pool,
   B. Learners should ignore Kenyan Indigenous Games completely.
   C. Kenyan Indigenous Games is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kenyan Indigenous Games.

23. About Kenyan Indigenous Games when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. execute a water entry skill using a pencil dive,
   B. Learners should ignore Kenyan Indigenous Games completely.
   C. Kenyan Indigenous Games is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kenyan Indigenous Games.

25. About Rhythm at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. outline factors to consider in creating a rhythmic pattern in simple time,
   B. Learners should ignore Rhythm completely.
   C. Rhythm is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Rhythm.

26. About Rhythm at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. compose a four- bar rhythmic pattern in 2 4 time,
   B. Learners should ignore Rhythm completely.
   C. Rhythm is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Rhythm.

27. About Rhythm when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. write rhythmic patterns in 2 4 on monotone from dictation,
   B. Learners should ignore Rhythm completely.
   C. Rhythm is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Rhythm.

29. About Javelin and Sculpture at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify materials for carving in sculpture,
   B. Learners should ignore Javelin and Sculpture completely.
   C. Javelin and Sculpture is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Javelin and Sculpture.

30. About Javelin and Sculpture at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. carve a javelin according to the right specification,
   B. Learners should ignore Javelin and Sculpture completely.
   C. Javelin and Sculpture is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Javelin and Sculpture.

31. About Javelin and Sculpture when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. decorate the javelin using appropriate techniques,
   B. Learners should ignore Javelin and Sculpture completely.
   C. Javelin and Sculpture is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Javelin and Sculpture.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports at home with your family.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Components of Creative Arts and Sports at home with your family.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Drawing and Painting at home with your family.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork at home with your family.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Swimming at home with your family.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Kenyan Indigenous Games at home with your family.

28. Give two examples of how you can use Rhythm at home with your family.

32. Give two examples of how you can use Javelin and Sculpture at home with your family.
